notes: Every flagship pool of the ten states, identified by pool_idx and labelled with its geographic state (the September slope dataset state tags are used only to join its slopes and the observation caches). Landsat series are pool-mean MNDWI per scene from the local Landsat stacks, 1985 on, all seasons; the viewer keeps June-August for the summer mode. Summer slopes (sl, t, sig, n) come from the slope dataset; all-year slopes (sly, ty, sigy, ny) are OLS fits over every scene computed by this script for the processed caches. Sentinel-2 (series_s2/, s2* properties): pool-mean MNDWI per scene from the local Sentinel-2 stacks (strict SCL + s2cloudless masking), 2015 on, with the same-scene median MNDWI of the surrounding marsh subtracted for the marsh-referenced value; s2 slopes are OLS fits of the marsh-referenced MNDWI (summer / all scenes, >= 14 scenes). tide = mean tidal range (MN) of the geographic unit datums; tsrc = datum source.
slopes: recomputed 2026-10-21 15:33 from the viewer series (OLS of the pool-mean index per scene; summer = Jun-Aug; >= 14 scenes); Sentinel-2 from marsh-referenced MNDWI
